description: Pallage Podinona v. Prathapage Nonachchi and Others Pallage Podinona v. Prathapage Nonachchi and Others View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: Pallage Podinona v. Prathapage Nonachchi and Others Pallage Podinona v. Prathapage Nonachchi and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s judgment in a partition action, claiming prescriptive title to the entire land through exclusive possession by her predecessors. Held - no evidence of independent adverse possession or any overt act sufficient to establish prescription. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
